items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Big Sidney went with Benny Goodman. He joined Benny Goodman in Detroit. ... So he said, 'Kenny, Pops digs you.'

ctx.x: Yeah, but where did he hear you?
Now, here's what happened. Big Sidney went with Benny Goodman. He joined Benny Goodman in Detroit.
